title: a cancelled task waits for the future it started to finish its async cleanup
purpose: Accept the construct and observe its result.

stdout.text:
cancel requested
child settled
parent cleanup
-1

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0; structured await by #147
provenance.expected_basis: The parent awaits child.run(); cancelling the parent cancels the child, whose deferred cleanup suspends on release; the parent runs its own defer and fails with Cancelled only after the child has settled.
